purpose: L7 fix: measurable kill rules for MARK research bets, reconciliation of the win-rate claims that shipped in MARK dispatch prompts, and a checkable scored-outcome definition for the top live bet.

win_rate_reconciliation.why: MARK dispatch prompts carried staff-lessons text with win rates that do not exist in any live store, and I repeated one of them in an r1 audit message. The left column is what the prompt claimed; the right column is what the stores say.

corrected.verdict: UNVERIFIABLE_AS_CLAIMED - prompt n=6 exceeds the 2 rows scored under this theme; raw win is 0.50, not 0.92
OVERSTATED - live n=3, raw 0.333, system 0.247; prompt n=7 matches no store
OVERSTATED - live n=3, raw 0.333, system 0.242; prompt n=15 matches no store
NO_PRIOR_CLAIM - unscored in the system summary, scored raw at 0.333

totals.note: The prompt's counts (6/7/15 = 28) cannot be reconstructed from any live store; treat all prompt-carried win rates as unverified until reproducible by mark_winrate.py.

kill_rules.name: lane freeze on measured decay
kill_rules.applies_to: every MARK continuous lane (sec-review, volatility-model, market-thesis, market-research)
kill_rules.tripwire: theme raw_win < 0.45 over the trailing 20 scored outcomes across 3 consecutive scoring revisions
kill_rules.action: FREEZE that lane: stop accepting dispatches for it, post [MARK/alert] on the bus, hand the lane to CH1P for reassignment
kill_rules.unfreeze: only after a written strategy change plus one scored outcome >= 0.50 on the new strategy
kill_rules.status_now: sec-review 0.333 / volatility-model 0.333 / market-thesis 0.333 (each n=3) - below 0.45 but window too small to trip; counted as WARN, revision 1 of 3

kill_rules.name: artifact-churn freeze
kill_rules.tripwire: any artifact family (e.g. AMBA_SEC_REVIEW_BRIEF) grows by >10 versions with zero new scored outcomes
kill_rules.action: FREEZE the family; refuse new versions until one scored outcome lands
kill_rules.evidence_now: AMBA_SEC_REVIEW_BRIEF at 126 versions, AMBA_THESIS at 52, MARKET_RESEARCH at 340, 843 files total in mark-backtest
kill_rules.status_now: TRIPPED - freeze in force from this revision

kill_rules.name: no unverifiable numbers
kill_rules.tripwire: a published win rate, hit rate, or expectation that cannot be reproduced from a named store with n >= 10
kill_rules.action: retract in the same channel, publish the reproducible figure; violation counts as one defect
kill_rules.escalate: 2 defects within any 10 runs => publishing rights frozen until re-verified by a peer lane
kill_rules.status_now: 1 defect on record (this r1 message repeated a prompt win rate); 1 of 2

kill_rules.name: sourcing rule
kill_rules.tripwire: any market number published without (source name, observation timestamp), or two artifacts in one run disagreeing on the same instrument
kill_rules.action: artifact is VOID for scoring; re-issue or retract; 2 defects per 10 runs => lane frozen
kill_rules.evidence_now: PREDICTION_MARKET_POSITION_REVIEW (BTC ~78,600, no source/ts) contradicts CRYPTO_TRADING_JOURNAL of the same day (BTC 81,235) = 3.4% internal contradiction

kill_rules.name: bet-level stop
kill_rules.tripwire: close <= entry x 0.98 at any observation before the horizon => close as MISS immediately
kill_rules.action: close the bet, record the outcome, do not re-enter the same direction without a new written thesis

kill_rules.name: data freshness
kill_rules.tripwire: a thesis scored on a quote older than 1 trading day, or a missing source/observation timestamp
kill_rules.action: outcome = VOID, not hit and not miss; the bet does not count in any win rate

kill_rules.name: no bet without a kill rule
kill_rules.tripwire: any thesis or paper position logged without an explicit kill rule and horizon
kill_rules.action: VOID at birth; the ledger row must carry kill_rule and horizon_end or it is not a bet
kill_rules.status_now: theses.jsonl holds 13 rows, all status=active, all outcome=None, none with a kill rule - 539 checks accumulated with zero scored outcomes; the top bet below is the first row that satisfies this rule

top_bet_scored_outcome.thesis: Crypto momentum continuation: BTC/ETH/SOL all green over the 2-day and 12-day windows at the 2026-09-22 observation; the bet is that momentum persists for 2 more trading days.
top_bet_scored_outcome.no_edge_rule: horizon reached with |move| < 2.0% on the primary instrument => outcome NO_EDGE (the thesis was not wrong, it was untestable)
top_bet_scored_outcome.winner_rule: primary instrument decides the bet outcome; ETH and SOL are recorded as corroboration only
top_bet_scored_outcome.example_kill_decision: If BTC prints 84,100 at any observation before 2026-09-24, K5 fires: outcome=miss, outcome_price=84100, outcome_source=<name>, outcome_ts=<ISO>, and the row is closed - no re-entry without a new written thesis.
how_yeshua_verifies: python3 shared-scratchpad/mark-backtest/mark_winrate.py  # reproduces every win rate above
grep CRYPTO-MOM-20260922 ~/.freebuff/market-research/theses.jsonl  # once scored, shows outcome fields

honest_gaps: No outcome has actually been scored yet - this revision defines the scoring; the 13 ledger rows still read outcome=None and the top bet's first score is due at the 2026-09-24 horizon.

K1 needs 3 scoring revisions before any lane can actually freeze; my lanes are WARN at 0.333 on n=3, which is too small a sample to declare decay - I am not claiming the number is precise, only that it is what the store records.
The prompt-carried win rates cannot be traced to a producing window, so the reconciliation states overstatement rather than a precise correction factor.
